recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up a hosted heartbeat monitor such as Healthchecks.io now: a cron wrapper pings it on start, on success and on failure, and email alerts fire on failed or overdue runs. It defers central logging and Docker on the Synology.
note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, makes Synology Docker optional and defers central logs until searchable logs are wanted, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
